analyst_observations: The skill achieves 100% assertion pass rate across all 3 evals vs 50% baseline — the biggest gains are in framework application and structured output.
WITHOUT skill, the model finds real bugs (enum coercion, legacy field names, SDR template gaps) but misses the WHY — it audits code structure, not marketing methodology coverage.

WITH skill, every finding is grounded in a named framework with atomic elements, producing findings the baseline never surfaces: Gad Social dimension, Keller Feelings taxonomy, Hormozi Effort/Sacrifice, WbD Critical Event, self-expressive benefits.
The skill costs ~36% more tokens and ~66% more time. This is expected — the model reads references/frameworks.md and produces richer, structured output.

The cohort course eval shows the biggest skill delta (33% → 100%): without skill, the model has zero framework awareness for offer-type audits. With skill, it correctly weights Hormozi/WbD/Casel as PRIMARY.
Both with and without skill correctly identify the #1 finding: agent_identity.j2 doesn't consume brand/offer data. The skill adds the methodology WHY and structured SDR readiness scoring.
